Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, 2004).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2004 as 'Rotary Sunrise'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, deep pink edges, golden-yellow shading. Moderate fragrance. Very double, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Remove spent blooms to encourage re-bloom. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
